scripts.build: tsx scripts/validate-workspaces.ts build && turbo run build
scripts.lint: tsx scripts/validate-workspaces.ts lint && eslint . && prettier --check . && turbo run lint
scripts.test: tsx scripts/validate-workspaces.ts test && vitest run --passWithNoTests && turbo run test
scripts.typecheck: tsx scripts/validate-workspaces.ts typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && turbo run typecheck
